description.value: The study investigated regional differences between morphologic and functional changes in the same patients with frontotemporal dementia using FDG-PET and voxel-based morphometric MRI.

spans.text: The aim of this study was to investigate the regional differences between the morphologic and functional changes in the same patients with frontotemporal dementia (FTD) using statistical parametric mapping and voxel-based morphometry (VBM).

description.value: A comparative study of FTD patients, Alzheimer’s disease patients, and normal volunteers who underwent both FDG-PET and MRI.

spans.text: The most interesting finding of the study is the demonstration of parallel registration of regional cortical atrophy and hypometabolism in different groups of neurodegeneration.
